scope: Recent-event (hot list) channel/topic filters: app/curation_hot_query.py story_member_filters, app/web/routes.py _top_clusters
environment: macOS rehearsal-size copy (89,575 items, 76,586 stories, schema 51); clock fixed at 2026-10-03T16:00Z, the end of the data, so the two-day window holds about 8k stories; no network, no model calls
problem: Without statistics the planner ran each story's channel EXISTS from idx_items_channel_pub, walking the channel's items for every recent story; with curation visibility joined this took seconds. Earlier portal timings used the real clock, whose two-day window was empty on this data
change: Channel and topic EXISTS start from the story's members (CROSS JOIN from story_items through idx_story_items_story) in both the legacy and the curated hot-metrics path; the legacy path checks for any visible member only when no channel/topic filter (which already requires one) applies
